note: Sign-in flow: the shop.com 'Sign in' control (a button in the desktop rail and the phone dock, also 'Sign in to view saved items') navigates the whole tab to a dedicated page on shop.app; there is no in-page modal or sheet. Email-first form, nothing submitted (empty submit only, a client-side check). Headless Chromium via Playwright, read-only, DPR 1, viewport screenshots.

measured.page: white page, no store chrome; one centred column 344px wide (phones: 24px side gutters), top at ~90px desktop / 16px phones; language switcher pinned to the bottom
measured.logo: 32px brand mark centred, 24px above the heading
measured.heading: h2 'Sign in to Shop' 32/35.2 800 -0.5px desktop, 28/30.8 phones, black, centred
measured.subtitle: 16/22 450 -0.5px, rgba(0,0,0,.56), 8px under the heading
measured.field: 52px pill wrapper: 1px solid #000, radius 999px, background rgba(0,0,0,.04), padding 0 16px, shadow 0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.02), 0 6px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.04); input 16/22 450 -0.5px, placeholder rgba(0,0,0,.35) as the only label (aria-label 'Enter your email'), type=email, autocomplete='email webauthn', autofocus; 24px under the subtitle
measured.primary: 52px pill 'Continue', 16/22 500 -0.5px, brand fill, 1px white edge, inset highlights rgba(255,255,255,.32) and 0 4px 24px brand at .24; 16px under the field
